findings.evidence: Choose the smallest real deliverable that tests one lesson and can be completed with the user's available time.
findings.fix: Compress derivable coaching lines like this and "Be direct, question-driven"; spend the tokens on the non-obvious rules (controllable criteria, one variable per rep, the evidence decision rule).

findings.evidence: - Extract only practice-worthy claims and techniques.
findings.fix: Add a prioritization rule for competing lessons: when several lessons could be Rep 1, pick the one with the smallest shippable test in the user's available time.

findings.evidence: - Never Make completion depend on an uncontrollable market response; otherwise the user can do the work and still be told they did not ship.
findings.fix: Add a gotcha: a source's motivational claims are not lessons; extracting them produces a rep that tests nothing.
Expand queries into full realistic messages with context, phrasing variety, and occasional typos; telegraphic phrases under-test the description.

findings.evidence: Save source, extracted lessons, Rep 1 deliverable/criteria/steps/reflection, and provisional future direction.
findings.fix: Add a five-line example Rep 1 (deliverable, controllable criterion, steps, reflection questions) so agents copy the plan shape instead of guessing it.
